text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: HOSTED-INFERENCE-500s (high 5xx rate) - incident #INC-2026-0478. Primary oncall paged.
maya (oncall): seeing traffic spike + 5xx surge on hosted inference. paging info in PD: https://pd.example/INC-2026-0478
maya (oncall): I can't ack from mobile right now, stuck in a meeting. leaving a note, someone else please ack if available.
sam (secondary): I'm awake, trying to ack... pd ack failing with 502 from PD API. getting: `502 Bad Gateway`
sam (secondary): incident-bot shows primary unacked -> secondary should be paged automatically but I see no secondary page. pagerduty-bot, did escalation fire?
pagerduty-bot: Escalation policy "infra-critical" triggered. Secondary page attempted. Manager escalation will fire in 7m if unacked.
luis (sre): checking runtime -> prometheus shows token-queue errors and spikes in host-gpu OOMs around 1750607500. logs: ```
[2026-02-18T12:45:03Z] inference/serve.go:211 - KV cache miss high, mem pressure
[2026-02-18T12:45:07Z] runtime/worker.go:98 - cuda: out of memory allocating 1.2GB
```
maya (oncall): thanks luis. can we throttle batch size or route to dedicated?
sam (secondary): trying to ack again: `/pd acknowledge INC-2026-0478 --user sam` -> still failing with network timeout. I'm going to jump onto the bridge.
olivia (manager): I'm on standby. if secondary can't ack PD in next 2m, manager escalation will page me. I can coordinate customer comms.
luis (sre): quick mitigation: switching traffic to fallback variant `redwood-small-quant` for hosted until kernel bug fixed. running: `rictl route set --model redwood-small-quant --target hosted` (will take ~20s).
maya (oncall): please confirm fallback reduces latency/cost? we need to avoid widespread 5xx for paying customers.
luis (sre): fallback applied, metrics: 5xx rate dropped from 7.8% -> 0.9% in 30s. CPU up but stable.
incident-bot: PagerDuty escalation: manager page fired to olivia at 1750607910 (no ack yet).
sam (secondary): I can join bridge now, but PD still shows me unacked. I'm on the bridge ID: redwood-infer-bridge-0478.
olivia (manager): acknowledged manager page via PD web. jumping to bridge. thanks for fast fallback, luis.
maya (oncall): notes for post-incident: investigate kernel selection heuristic that caused OOM on large-batch paths; add PD mobile retry logic.
luis (sre): logs indicate a kernel regression introduced in runtime v2.4.3 deployed last night. will open a rollback PR. running emergency rollback to v2.4.2 on affected pool: `rictl deploy rollback --runtime v2.4.2 --pool hosted-rt-1`
sam (secondary): PD ack finally went through (laggy). acked at 1750607938. marking incident as assigned.
incident-bot: Incident assigned to sam (secondary). PagerDuty: ACK recorded. Manager olivia also joined bridge.
olivia (manager): customer impact: partial errors for routed hosted customers for ~2m window before fallback, estimated ~120 affected API keys; PRD impact level: P2 (customer-facing, degraded but mitigated). drafting status update.
maya (oncall): adding follow-up tasks: 1) hotfix rollback validation + canary 2) restore kernel test in CI 3) PD mobile retry + oncall handoff doc tweak.
luis (sre): opening ticket INFRA-1229 with findings + attach heap traces.
sam (secondary): I'll stay on bridge until rollout validated. can we keep a 15m post-mortem smoke window?
olivia (manager): yes. I'll wait 20m and then send customer note draft for review.
incident-bot: Incident closed in PD? not yet. leaving thread open until rollback completes and 15m steady-state observed.
maya (oncall): thanks everyone. short postmortem to follow. :thumbsup:
